answer: Proof-of-stake acts as a secure inlet for agent participation, requiring capital commitment to prevent Sybil proliferation. By staking tokens, nodes flow like a river into a consensus set where identity is tethered to verifiable economic risk. An attacker must acquire a majority of the circulating supply to subvert the system, a cost that serves as a beacon of deterrence, rendering the creation of infinite, low-cost fake identities prohibitively expensive and economically irrational.
